confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation. Argentina's peso moves quickly, so USD prices can shift within months. Cocktail was set at about 2x the beer anchor and wine glass at about 1.1x beer, because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. The FX rate comes from a search-result summary that cited RBA figures; the RBA page itself was not read directly in this session, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against tourist-facing Latin American capitals with similar restaurant and hotel price levels, such as Santiago and Montevideo, adjusted for Buenos Aires's currency volatility and July winter season.
